title: The White Tower
subtitle: Power and reason were pressed into white bricks, and the great statue built from them is unbreakable.

trails.title: Assembly
trails.description: Heroes, unite! Raise the flag—it's time to fight back!

trails.title: Blame Game
trails.description: Failure never lacks for explanations. Don't worry—they'll always find a scapegoat.

content.text:
153025Z The Guiding One has left. We should withdraw as well.
153101Z Do you hear the singing? It's Lyra.
153110Z Taira, put your blade away. Don't get drawn into the fight. İlmek, let's go.
153122Z Krutov, are you satisfied?
153130Z You're grinding your teeth too. You've got no room to talk.
153139Z Our objective is met. There's no point in lingering.
153141Z Don't let them learn the secret of the network.
153148Z Idiot! Moth already pulled intel from that useless Prima's head!
153152Z Let's move. Ustrina, don't be angry.
153200Z Is she brainless? Can't she just lock the room with her arcane skill?

items.text: The White Tower
Hallway, Committee Tower

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Fall back to the Spire.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: If you encounter Arcana, do not engage. I repeat, no hostile action.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: If anyone shows signs of panic or pessimism, restrain them and get them away from Arcana immediately.

items.speaker: Irinei
items.text: You ever pictured your own death, Pedra? Ever thought it would feature the two of us, side by side?

items.speaker: Pedra
items.text: I'd usually suggest a bit more positivity, but that may be naive given the situation. I might have a few tips on dying with dignity, though.

items.speaker: Irinei
items.text: Thanks, but that much I've already figured out. Creius, give me your pistol.

items.speaker: Creius
items.text: Take it. Just promise me you aren't saving the last round for yourself.

items.speaker: Irinei
items.text: If I go down to my last bullet, I'm gunning for Arcana's head.

items.speaker: Pedra
items.text: Well said, Irinei. I don't think we've ever agreed more.
Krutov's army has occupied the entirety of the Committee Building beneath them. The remaining resistance forms a shrinking cordon at the upper levels.
The Spire was not built for shelter, but at this point, they have nowhere else to run.
She yearns to hear the trees' whispers once more, to nurture new saplings, but try as she might, it's all in vain.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Druvis! There you are.
Regulus splits away from the crowd.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: Regulus? Did you find Mr. APPLe?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That I did. He's here in my bag. I thought he'd flown out when we landed.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That was a rough fall. How's Nautika holding up?
In her surprise, she senses someone familiar brush up against her.
She turns and sees Marsha carrying someone over.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Marsha? Who've you got there? The bard?

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: *sigh* I found her trapped under a filing cabinet.
There's obvious pain in her voice. Without her arcane skill, she's forced to consciously bear each and every wound she's sustained.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: She's alive. Just in a coma, same as the Awakened.

items.speaker: Operation Team Leader I
items.text: We have eyes on Arcana.
The alert incites a wave of fear.
Druvis looks behind her. They're being pushed back as far as they can possibly go.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: There isn't much space in the Spire. We'll all end up crowded in a room.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh, gods of rock have mercy. Please don't let me die in some stodgy old president's office.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: The rest of the Manus are cut off. Without reinforcements, our soldiers should be able to keep them out of the Spire. It's only Arcana that has broken through.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: We are not her goal. Whatever it is, she's decided to leave us be for now.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: I see.
She hates this feeling of helplessness, but there's nothing more that she can do.

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: Let's get Recoleta somewhere safer.
The president's office—the sole room at the top of the Spire—would be considered rather spacious under normal circumstances.
But the crowds of survivors make it feel unbearably cramped.
The president stands behind his desk, observing the chaos and waiting.

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: She ... She's right behind us.
Before long, the final group of survivors enters the office.
They all look on as Arcana steps inside.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: A most remarkable spire, I must admit, Mr. President.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: How many uncounted years of labor were devoted to its construction? To this pretty monument to man's hubris?

items.speaker: Foundation Security
items.text: D-Don't let her come any closer.
The loyal guard falls to his knees, and as he does, all the other armed personnel in the room seem to lose their will to resist, too.
All courage seems to disappear from them like smoke wisping away into the breeze.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Enough of this.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Sir?
He waves away the rebuttal and leaves his guards' protection to stand before Arcana.

items.speaker: President
items.text: What is it you want, Arcana?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Only to speak.

items.speaker: President
items.text: You would do all this, bring about so much pain and destruction, just to speak?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Destruction?
She seems inexplicably puzzled.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: To cause such misery hath never been my intent.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: But alas, my children are unruly at times. Their chaotic natures drive them to violent ends.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Violent indeed. I'm sure you'd agree your forces have suffered considerably to get you this far.

items.speaker: President
items.text: So, what is this? Just entertainment to you? Like all the wars you've provoked?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: What wars have I provoked? None that were not first designed in the arrogance and bloodlust of human hearts.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Millions lie dead—fallen to thy machines, lost in the bloody hatreds of thine own kind.
An elliptical barrier appears around them. The president and Arcana stand at its two focal points.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Fear not. I desire only a little privacy.

items.speaker: President
items.text: For what purpose?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: An audience with the Philosopher King, ruler of the Pax House.

items.speaker: President
items.text: I am authorized to speak on his behalf.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Yet thou art too young to speak on matters of the Blank Era.

items.speaker: President
items.text: The Philosopher King will not leave the Pax House just to answer your questions.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Indeed not. For hath anyone e'er seen him stride beyond those walls?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: How long hath he dwelt therein, isolated from this world? Doth he know his utopia shall never come to pass?

items.speaker: President
items.text: His kingdom will come.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thou speakest words of faith, Mr. President, not of fact.

items.speaker: President
items.text: I trust in his vision.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Pray tell, was his vision unable to foresee this day, or was he simply too feeble to prevent it?

items.speaker: President
items.text: In his design, all may be sacrificed, all may be replaced. Whether we live or die today makes no difference. Should we fall, more of us will arise to carry on the mission.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: "More of us"—thy meaning is clear. Ever obsessed with these inferior beings. Only they might fulfill his ideals; only they may prove worthy of his new world.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Alas, that this vision of humanity is mere fabrication—
A noise interrupts their discussion.
Outside, statue-like warriors cleave at the barrier.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The Core Guard.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Then the Philosopher King foresaw some answer for me after all.

items.speaker: President
items.text: You knew about them?

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: And long have I been curious of them. I suspect I am not alone in that.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Who would not wish to meet with mankind perfected? The ideal citizens of a brave new world, unshakable against the tides of pneuma.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The purest creations of the Pax House.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Taunt all you like, Arcana, but there's little you know about humans. You have always underestimated their potential.

items.speaker: President
items.text: The master of history is not easily challenged.
The barrier begins to crack under the warriors' blades.

items.speaker: "Breacher"
items.text: The barrier will be breached shortly.

items.speaker: "Leader"
items.text: Prepare to engage.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Welcome back, Vertin.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I am heartened to see that thou hast opened my "boon."

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thine attempts to turn thy newfound power on me have not gone unnoticed.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Very well. I shall leave thee to thine workings. May thou find it worthwhile.
Following the brief diversion, Arcana returns her focus to the president.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Thy Foundation's hospitality hath grown cold, Mr. President.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Stay awhile. I promise things will get heated shortly.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Heh. How enticing.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Yet my aims have been met.
She raises a hand.
A seed falls from within her palm.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: As a token of courtesy, allow me to leave something behind for this young brood of the Pax House.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Farewell, mortals.
White light shines from the floating room, making the Spire look like a lighthouse from a bygone era.
The radiance recedes, and the world takes back its contrast.

items.speaker: Marsha
items.text: It's gone. Have we won?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Seems like that might have been the ticket. The air feels a bit lighter now, don't you think?

items.speaker: Druvis III
items.text: I'm concerned that might have something to do with the building collapsing around us. Everyone, onto the branches, please. I'll bring us down safely.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: No need to panic. That's just the architect beginning her work.

items.speaker: "Leader"
items.text: All units, gather at the entrance.

items.speaker: "Leader"
items.text: The enemy is retreating. Eliminate any remaining Manus Vindictae forces inside the building.
The Pax House's guard soon restores order, and those still capable of fighting leave the office and prepare to retake the Committee Building.
As the room quiets, the Secretary General approaches her superior.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: It's over, Mr. President. The creature has been eliminated.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Without Arcana's presence, the Manus army won't hold out for long.
On the floor before him lies a puddle of dark sludge.

items.speaker: President
items.text: One would expect more maturity from a god.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Did we learn anything regarding Arcana's power?

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: The Foundation held her back long enough for us to conduct a full assessment. The results align with our speculation.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: She has dominion over the "channels" of pneuma in this world. In other words, she can control the very flow of arcanum itself.

items.speaker: President
items.text: That explains how she severed us from our powers.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Precisely. Now that communications have resumed, we've been able to reestablish contact with our field operatives. Ms. Stranger reports that she's discovered how Manus Vindictae breached our security.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Excellent. Send support to her immediately. Her safety is of extreme importance to our efforts.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: I understand that she's already under the protection of a Flying Witch.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Good. We should count ourselves lucky. Had Arcana wished it, we would have suffered much greater losses.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: A god cannot be killed by mortal hands.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: Only slain by the hand of another.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Do we know Vertin's status?

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: If I'm not mistaken, she intervened somehow. She challenged Arcana in this very room.

items.speaker: Secretary General
items.text: If not for her, the Core Guard might not have been able to breach the barrier.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Then we can worry about her later.
He turns toward the window.

items.speaker: President
items.text: The SPDM should be secured by now.
